The AI investment trade will be protected from implosion because key stakeholders (implicitly including policymakers and market participants) will ensure high-profile AI IPOs like Anthropic succeed.

Gen Z and millennial incomes and balance sheets are ahead of prior generations at comparable ages, meaning the dominant narrative of younger cohorts falling financially behind is not supported by data.

The K-shaped economy narrative is empirically flawed because while the wealthy are getting richer, lower-income cohorts are also making absolute progress — there is no sustained downward leg in the distribution.
Record tanker rates driven by Middle East conflict are creating a regional heavy crude glut in the Americas, pushing Canadian, Colombian, and Ecuadorian crude prices down ~$10/barrel.
The global diesel crunch is structural and unlikely to resolve soon, as tanker shortages prevent heavy crude — the primary diesel feedstock — from reaching refiners in Asia and Europe.

Middle East-driven tanker rate inflation has created a durable structural bifurcation in global crude markets, where geographically disadvantaged producers face deep discounts while sanctioned producers (Russia, Iran) paradoxically command premium prices.

Saudi Arabia's sovereign wealth fund (PIF) is experiencing fiscal strain that is forcing it to cut major infrastructure commitments, including World Cup stadiums, signaling a broader pullback in Gulf megaproject spending.

Europe faces a severe winter energy crisis driven by historically low gas storage levels and sustained Strait of Hormuz disruptions from the Iran war, threatening households and industrial production.
Political uncertainty around potential housing regulations — even when not yet enacted — suppresses real estate investment by making long-horizon, illiquid capital commitments untenable.
Global liquidity is in a short-term contractionary phase, with consecutive weekly declines driven by collateral stress and a strong dollar, prompting investors to reduce risk exposure.

This cycle represents a golden age for crypto long/short strategies because deteriorating projects are trending persistently lower (profitable short legs) while fundamentally strong assets trend higher, allowing both legs to contribute positive returns simultaneously.
Toyota is losing significant market share in China due to intensifying domestic competition and pricing pressure, with sales falling sharply year over year.

The US-Iran military stalemate risks an imminent escalation — either an Iranian 'October surprise' or a US strike — driven by domestic political calculus around the midterm elections rather than strategic logic, creating a high near-term tail risk event.

The US military has suffered severe and slow-to-recover depletion of missile interceptor stockpiles (~70% of THAAD, ~50% of Patriot, ~75% of long-range ballistic missiles), creating a dangerous near-term window of strategic vulnerability that benefits China and Russia at minimal cost to them.

China and Russia are providing Iran with critical intelligence and targeting support (satellite imagery, electronic warfare), effectively using Iran as a low-cost proxy to degrade US military capabilities and regional dominance without direct confrontation.
Targeting of chemical tankers near Romania's coast suggests the conflict is expanding beyond Ukrainian-flagged vessels to commercial shipping of NATO-adjacent states, raising escalation risk.
Chinese automakers have achieved dominant global EV market share through structural advantages — vertical integration, state support, and scale — that Western firms cannot easily replicate.
Hybrid vehicles are emerging as the pragmatic near-term winner as consumers reject full battery-EV mandates, benefiting Japanese automakers who avoided the all-in EV bet.
Chinese AI portfolio companies backed by now-sanctioned investors face material disruption to planned Hong Kong IPO timelines, creating a new category of capital-markets risk for China tech listings.

The author explicitly warns that the US faces the same fiscal trajectory as Europe if it continues expanding the welfare state, framing European dysfunction as a leading indicator for American policy risk.

A gold revaluation to $20,000-$22,000 would not be seen as a monetary default if policymakers simultaneously manage bond yields lower and equity prices higher, as US investors will follow price signals rather than the underlying mechanism.

A German energy shortage this winter could act as a black swan for the euro, triggering dollar strength, which in turn would push long-term Treasury yields higher and accelerate systemic insolvencies globally.
Interest rates will trend higher until aggressive policy action caps them, meaning the recent rate decline was a bear market rally rather than the start of a sustained easing cycle.
Gold is increasingly driven by Chinese monetary conditions and PBOC policy rather than Western central bank policy, reducing its usefulness as a barometer of US/Western liquidity.

Escalating Houthi missile attacks are systematically disrupting Saudi Arabia's economic diversification program (Vision 2030) by forcing cancellation of major international events and deterring foreign investment.

The war has paradoxically strengthened the Iranian regime's domestic legitimacy by redirecting popular anger toward external enemies (the US and Israel), making regime collapse or internal change unlikely for the duration of the conflict.

France's social unrest has escalated to a point where French sovereign bond yields have hit 24-year highs near 5%, with Bund spreads near 160bps and a Moody's rating review pending, signaling a meaningful credit stress event.
Escalating drone attacks on Black Sea shipping are disrupting a critical export corridor for Ukrainian and Russian grain, threatening global food supply chains.

US sanctions targeting the capital behind AI trade secret theft (MiraclePlus funds) represent a meaningful escalation in US-China tech decoupling enforcement, signaling that investors in stolen-IP ventures now face direct financial penalties.

NATO's publicly revealed conventional-drone-precision-strike war doctrine is not new and mirrors what both sides have been developing since the Ukraine conflict began, leaving the fundamental escalation dynamic unchanged.

Russia's medium-term defense strategy will likely mirror NATO's doctrine symmetrically — building physical barriers, a drone wall, and expanded air defenses — entrenching a prolonged arms-buildup cycle in Europe.

The risk of nuclear escalation by miscalculation is non-trivial and could occur rapidly — potentially within the first hours of a conventional conflict — making diplomatic de-escalation urgently necessary.
Russia is conducting a coordinated hybrid warfare campaign against NATO infrastructure in Eastern Europe, targeting Starlink communications nodes supporting Ukraine's military operations.

A potential Le Pen presidency in 2027 risks significant social instability and emigration sentiment among French Muslim and Jewish communities, signaling elevated political risk in France and Europe more broadly.
Post-2008 ultra-low and negative interest rates were a historical anomaly, and the current elevated yield environment represents a return to long-run norms rather than a temporary dislocation.
After years of financial repression, bonds may now be worth buying again given that they offer meaningful income, but the answer depends on understanding why yields are currently high.
Policymakers are structurally constrained from aggressive financial tightening by the scale of global debt burdens, putting a ceiling on how restrictive monetary policy can become.
U.S. LNG exports are increasingly redirected to Europe, providing partial relief to European gas deficits but insufficient to close the storage gap before winter.

The Iran war-driven energy shock is causing broader European economic damage — rising industrial costs, potential factory shutdowns, and significant job losses — that may require government intervention.

Massive downward revisions to retail sales (>5%), payrolls, and industrial production reveal that the post-2022 'resilient consumer' narrative was a statistical fiction sustained by biased modeling assumptions.

Inflation-adjusted retail sales had fallen below the already weak 2010s trend baseline by 2023, meaning households were paying more while consuming less in real terms — a condition of genuine economic deterioration masked by nominal spending data.
The collateral multiplier is acting as a temporary buffer against liquidity weakness, but rising volatility poses a latent risk of tighter collateral haircuts that could amplify the contraction.

Bitcoin remains the de facto benchmark for crypto fund performance evaluation despite significant sectoral dispersion, because LPs lack better alternatives and ETF access (IBIT) has set a minimum performance bar that active funds must clear.
Global EV adoption is falling short of earlier industry expectations, forcing automakers toward multi-powertrain flexibility rather than pure electrification commitments.
Most people lack the conceptual framework to evaluate macroeconomic information, leaving them dependent on unreliable institutional sources and unable to make confident financial decisions.
Crypto-AI intersection is maturing into legitimate use cases, particularly around privacy-preserving inference, permissionless agent coordination, and decentralized data storage for AI agent swarms.

Bitcoin remains the de facto benchmark for crypto fund performance despite growing sectoral dispersion, because LPs lack viable alternative indices and can access BTC exposure cheaply via ETFs like IBIT.

France's social unrest is rooted not primarily in immigration volume but in decades of deliberate isolation and failed assimilation of second- and third-generation African-origin populations, creating a structural powder keg distinct from other European nations.
Understanding the economy requires going to first principles about where information comes from and how to read it correctly, because mainstream economic frameworks are fundamentally misleading.
The growing normalization of attacks on civilian energy infrastructure, particularly refineries, poses a serious and escalating risk to global energy supply chains.
NATO's decision to deploy surveillance assets and forensic teams to the Black Sea signals a formal escalation of alliance involvement in the Ukraine-Russia conflict zone.

The Federal Reserve serves primarily as a political scapegoat mechanism for politicians, allowing credit-taking in good times and blame-shifting in bad times, rather than functioning as a genuine monetary authority.
Chinese EV makers are encircling US auto markets via Brazil, Mexico, and Canada, creating a medium-term competitive threat to US automakers even as US tariffs block direct imports.
Europe's decades-long welfare state expansion has destroyed competitiveness, fueled inflation, and generated social unrest that is now manifesting in violent street protests.

Europe's unfunded pension liabilities — ranging from 347% to 500% of GDP across major economies — represent an existential fiscal time bomb that cannot be resolved without either generational tax crushing or currency debasement.

European social unrest is occurring six months before the French presidential election, creating a near-term political risk catalyst that could accelerate fiscal or policy instability in the eurozone's second-largest economy.
Barclays is cutting approximately 5,000 jobs (5% of workforce) by leveraging AI-driven efficiency gains and structural cost reduction programs.

UK youth employment in technology and finance has collapsed structurally — down 30% and 10% respectively since 2022 — suggesting AI and post-pandemic structural shifts are permanently displacing entry-level workers from high-value sectors.
US corporate job cuts in 2026 are running at approximately 702,000 across 541 companies year-to-date (~2,300/day), indicating a broadly deteriorating US labor market.

Social media and smartphone culture are the primary driver of younger generations' inflated financial expectations and record pessimism, but a turning point may have been reached as guardrails (school bans, parental controls) are now being implemented.

China's gold accumulation is driven by existential self-interest: converting yuan-denominated commodity trade settlement into a gold-backed offshore yuan system to avoid a dollar shortage crisis, not to destroy the dollar.

A properly functioning monetary system enables productive disinflation — goods prices fall faster than currency devalues, making labor progressively more valuable — which is the natural and healthy state of a free market economy.

trends.headline: Aging megatrend beschleunigt: Baby-Boomer-Welle trifft auf Angebotsengpass bei Senior Housing, während Moody's 2029-Tipping-Point fuer Staatsfinanzen warnt.
trends.bull_case: Die demografische Welle ist unumkehrbar — mehr als 400 Mio. Menschen 60+ in China bis 2035, Baby Boomer in den USA werden 80, bei gleichzeitig stagnierendem Senior-Housing-Bau. Der Silver-Economy-Markt wächst mit 9,86% CAGR auf 223 Mrd. USD bis 2034, was strukturelle, nicht-zyklische Nachfrage fuer REITs wie Ventas und EdTech-Anbieter schafft. Die ETF-Landschaft fuer diesen Trend (AGED, EDUT) ist duenn und illiquide, was Positions-Sizing einschraenkt.

CBDC-Rollout in 73% des globalen BIP schafft regulatorische Interoperabilitätsbasis, die DeFi-Integration legitimiert und Kapitalflüsse in tokenisierte Assets katalysiert. Fragmentierung traditioneller Kapitalmärkte wird durch 24/7-Settlement (HK wCBDC) und Micro-Investment-Zugang ($100-Tickets) strukturell adressiert.
trends.bear_case: US-Regulierung bleibt blockiert – Fed hat per Executive Order CBDC-Entwicklung gestoppt, was den größten Kapitalmarkt vom globalen Tokenisierungs-Ökosystem abkoppelt. ETF-Flow-Score von nur 13.8/100 signalisiert, dass institutionelles Kapital trotz Medien-Hype nicht in nennenswertem Umfang in handelbare Vehikel fließt. Rechtliche Unsicherheit bei Security Token Offerings und ungelöste Custody-Haftungsfragen bremsen skalierbare Adoption.

Agentic AI verlässt die Pilot-Phase (UiPath/GeekWire Awards), was strukturelle Produktivitätsgewinne in Unternehmen beschleunigt. Energieeffizienz-Durchbrüche (100x Reduktion) könnten den grössten Skalierungsengpass beseitigen und Capex-Zyklen verlängern.

Chinas CXMT-Durchbruch bei Memory-Chips könnte westliche AI-Hardware-Margen strukturell komprimieren und den Halbleiter-Moat erodieren. Steigende Umweltkosten und regulatorische Unsicherheit könnten die Investitionsrenditen zeitlich verschieben.

briefing.headline: KI-Monetarisierung und Space-Economy-Skalierung dominieren die strukturelle Alpha-Landschaft im späten Expansionszyklus.
briefing.body: Das makroökonomische Umfeld per 18. Oktober 2026 ist durch ein reifes Expansionsregime geprägt, das selektive Positionierung in strukturellen Megatrends begünstigt, jedoch erhöhte Disziplin bei Sizing und Risikobudgetierung erfordert. Der Regime-Multiplikator von 0.75 reflektiert die erhöhte Vulnerabilität gegenüber Late-Cycle-Volatilität und die Notwendigkeit, Asymmetrie gegenüber absolutem Exposure zu priorisieren. Innerhalb dieses Kontexts stechen drei Themen als primäre Überzeugungsträger hervor: Artificial Intelligence, Space & Defense sowie Demographics & Society. Der OpenAI-Mathematik-Durchbruch signalisiert, dass KI die Phase reiner Infrastruktur-Investitionen verlässt und in die Enterprise-Monetarisierungsphase eintritt. Software-Plattformen mit verifizierten Produktivitätsgewinnen beginnen Pricing-Power durchzusetzen – ein Katalysator, der den AI-Trend trotz Reife-Score von 62 mit Momentum 91 und stabilem Acceleration-Wert von 0 weiterhin investierbar hält. Die Space Economy verdoppelte ihr Investitionsvolumen auf 23 Milliarden Dollar in zwölf Monaten. Der ACCELERATING-Status bei Maturity 42 und Momentum 88 signalisiert, dass dieser Trend noch erheblichen Runway vor sich hat. Dual-Use-Infrastruktur und fallende Launch-Kosten schaffen ein robustes strukturelles Fundament. Im demografischen Bereich trifft die Baby-Boomer-Welle auf einen Angebotsengpass bei Senior Housing – der fiskalische Druck treibt die Privatisierung der Altersvorsorge und eröffnet mittel- bis langfristige Positionierungsmöglichkeiten in der Silver Economy. Regulatorische Divergenz zwischen US-Deregulierung und EU AI Act Enforcement schafft komplexe Landscape: Kapitalstarke Incumbents in Fintech und KI profitieren überproportional von regulatorischen Moats. Die WATCH-Trends Quantum Computing und Biotech & Longevity zeigen beide Acceleration-Signale (8 bzw. 2) und könnten in den kommenden Quartalen in den ACTIVE-Status aufsteigen. Besondere Aufmerksamkeit verdient der Quantum-Trend mit Momentum 90 und Crowding 42 – eine ungewöhnlich günstige Kombination aus hohem Impuls und geringer Überfüllung. Contrarian-Positionen in URNM, ICLN und REMX bleiben strukturell interessant, da die Energie-Transition trotz Marktaversion treibende Kraft bleibt. Die vollständigen Blind-Spot-Quoten für die vier ACTIVE-Trends mahnen zur erhöhten Wachsamkeit: Neue Informationen in diesen Bereichen könnten Neubewertungen erzwingen.

sections.title: Strukturelle Verschiebungen
sections.content: Der AI-Trend zeigt eine kritische Reifephase-Transition von Infrastruktur zu Monetarisierung: Enterprise-Software mit nachweisbarem ROI übernimmt die Führung von Hardware-Investitionen. Space & Defense im ACCELERATING-Status mit Maturity 42 signalisiert den frühesten und damit attraktivsten Einstiegspunkt unter den ACTIVE-Trends, unterstützt durch staatlich-private Partnerschaften als strukturellen Treiber. Demographics & Society nähert sich mit Inflection-Score 51 einem kritischen Wendepunkt, an dem fiskalische Zwänge die Privatisierungsdynamik merklich beschleunigen dürften.

sections.title: Convergence-Analyse
sections.content: Die Konvergenz von Space & Defense mit Cyber & Digital Infrastructure schafft eine Dual-Use-Sphäre, in der Satelliten-Kommunikation und Cybersecurity-Anforderungen für militärische wie kommerzielle Betreiber verschmelzen – ein Multiplikatoreffekt für Defense-Tech-Plattformen. Die Supply Chain & Manufacturing plus Robotics & Automation Konvergenz beschleunigt die Re-Shoring-Welle: Automatisierte Fertigungsinfrastruktur wird zum investierbaren Vehikel für den geopolitisch motivierten Produktionswandel. Beide Convergence-Zonen sind im LATE_EXPANSION-Regime besonders attraktiv, da sie strukturelle Nachfrage unabhängig von konjunkturellen Schwankungen generieren.

Die Bevorzugung von Trends mit niedrigem Crowding (D2: 31, D3: 32, D4: 35) gegenüber reiferen, stärker besetzten Themen ist im aktuellen Regime besonders opportunistisch. Liquiditätsmanagement und Tail-Risk-Absicherung werden priorisiert: ACTIVE-Trends mit hohem Momentum aber negativer Acceleration (D11: -10, D12: -8) verdienen erhöhte Monitoring-Frequenz.

sections.title: Blind Spots & Contrarian

Die Contrarian-Positionen in URNM und ICLN profitieren von der strukturellen KI-Energienachfrage: Rechenzentren treiben Nachfrage nach unterbrechungsfreier Basislastenergie, was Uranium und Clean Energy als komplementäre Tail-Hedges positioniert. REMX als Rare-Earth-Exposure bleibt ein geopolitisch aufgeladener Contrarian-Trade, der bei Eskalation von Ressourcen-Nationalismus überproportional profitiert.

sections.title: Causal Chain Fruehwarnung
sections.content: Der nächste Schritt in der AI-Kausalkette – Enterprise-Monetarisierung mit Pricing-Power – sollte in Q4 2026 durch Unternehmensberichte mit expliziten KI-ROI-Metriken sichtbar werden und als Trigger für erhöhte Conviction dienen. In Space & Defense signalisiert die erwartete Skalierung kommerzieller Satellitenkonstellationen und ein mögliches SpaceX-IPO einen katalytischen Event-Horizont, der Sektor-Repricing auslösen könnte. Die Quantum-Computing-Kausalkette mit Advantage-Demonstrationen in Nischen-Anwendungen könnte den Übergang von WATCH zu ACTIVE innerhalb der nächsten 6 Monate einleiten, getrieben durch steigende Enterprise-Adoptionssignale.

core.name: High Yield Credit Spreads (OAS)
core.what: Der Risikoaufschlag, den Unternehmen mit schwacher Bonitaet gegenueber Staatsanleihen zahlen muessen. Misst den Grad an Credit-Stress im Markt — je hoeher der Spread, desto mehr Angst vor Zahlungsausfaellen.
core.thresholds: Unter 300 bps = entspannt (Maerkte sorglos). 300-450 bps = normal. 450-600 bps = erhoehte Vorsicht. Ueber 600 bps = akuter Stress (2008: 2000+ bps).
core.why_it_matters: HYG ist die direkteste Verbindung — jede Spread-Ausweitung um 50 bps kostet ca. 2-3% im HYG-Preis. Auch DBC und Rohstoffe leiden indirekt, weil hohe Spreads Rezessionsangst signalisieren.

core.name: Marktbreite (Advance/Decline Proxy)
core.what: Misst wie breit eine Rallye oder ein Sell-Off getragen wird. Hohe Breadth = viele Aktien steigen (gesunde Rallye). Niedrige Breadth = nur wenige Mega-Caps tragen den Index (fragil).
core.thresholds: Ueber 1.5 = sehr gesund. 1.0-1.5 = normal. 0.5-1.0 = schwaecher. Unter 0.5 fuer 3+ Tage = Breadth Collapse (-10 Punkte Composite Penalty).
core.why_it_matters: Fallende Breadth in LATE_EXPANSION ist ein klassisches Zyklusende-Signal. Wenn nur 5-10 Mega-Caps den Markt tragen, steigt das Risiko eines breiten Sell-Offs der alle Positionen trifft.

core.name: Copper/Gold Ratio
core.what: Kupferpreis geteilt durch Goldpreis. Kupfer = Industrie (steigt bei Wachstum), Gold = Sicherheit (steigt bei Angst). Das Ratio misst 'Wachstum vs. Sicherheit' im Markt.
core.thresholds: Ueber 0.25 = starke Wirtschaft. 0.18-0.25 = normal. 0.12-0.18 = Schwaeche. Unter 0.12 = extreme Risikoaversion. Trend wichtiger als Niveau.
core.why_it_matters: Direkt relevant fuer DBC: fallendes Ratio = nachlassende Industrienachfrage = DBC unter Druck. GLD profitiert gleichzeitig. In LATE_EXPANSION hat CU/AU 15% Gewicht — dritthoechstes im Composite.

core.name: VIX Term Structure (VIX/VIX3M Ratio)
core.what: Verhaeltnis zwischen kurzfristiger (30d) und mittelfristiger (90d) erwarteter Aktienvolatilitaet. Normalerweise ist kurzfristige Vol niedriger (Ratio unter 1.0). Wenn das Ratio ueber 1.0 steigt (Inversion), erwarten Haendler JETZT mehr Turbulenzen als in 3 Monaten — ein Panik-Signal.
core.thresholds: Unter 0.85 = sehr ruhig. 0.85-0.95 = normal. 0.95-1.0 = erhoehte Wachsamkeit. Ueber 1.0 = INVERTIERT — automatisch -15 Punkte Composite Penalty.
core.why_it_matters: Inversion trifft alle Risk-On-Positionen (HYG, DBC). GLD profitiert typischerweise als Safe Haven. Einer der zuverlaessigsten Stress-Indikatoren ueberhaupt.

core.name: Netto-Liquiditaet (Fed Reserve Drain Proxy)
core.what: Verfuegbare Liquiditaet im Finanzsystem: Fed-Bilanz minus Treasury General Account minus Reverse Repo. Steigende Liquiditaet hebt alle Risiko-Assets. Fallende Liquiditaet drueckt alles.
core.thresholds: Ueber $6.5T = reichlich. $5.5-6.5T = normal. Unter $5.5T = restriktiv. Unter $5.0T = Stress. Die Richtung (steigend/fallend) ist wichtiger als das Niveau.
core.why_it_matters: Liquiditaet ist der wichtigste Makro-Treiber fuer ALLE Assets im Portfolio. Steigende Liq hebt DBC, GLD und HYG gleichzeitig. Fallende Liq drueckt alles — kein Versteck ausser Cash und kurze Treasuries.

regime_sensitive.name: Yield Curve 10Y-2Y (Zinsstrukturkurve)
regime_sensitive.what: Differenz zwischen 10-Jahres- und 2-Jahres-US-Staatsanleihenrendite. Negativ = invertiert — historisch der zuverlaessigste Rezessions-Indikator. Jede US-Rezession seit 1970 wurde vorhergesagt (Vorlauf 6-18 Monate).
regime_sensitive.thresholds: Ueber +1.0% = steil (Erholung). 0 bis +1.0% = normal. -0.5 bis 0% = flach/leicht invertiert (Warnsignal). Unter -0.5% = tief invertiert (Rezession wahrscheinlich). ACHTUNG: Re-Steepening (zurueck zu positiv) ist oft die gefaehrlichste Phase — signalisiert unmittelbar bevorstehende Rezession.
regime_sensitive.why_it_matters: Direkte Implikation fuer V16-Regime: Reinversion oder schnelles Steepening kann Regime-Wechsel ausloesen. HYG besonders verwundbar bei Shift zu CONTRACTION.

regime_sensitive.name: MOVE Index (Bond-Volatilitaet)
regime_sensitive.what: Der 'VIX fuer Anleihen' — erwartete Volatilitaet am US-Treasury-Markt. Hohe Werte = Unsicherheit ueber Zinsentwicklung und Fed-Politik. Seit 2022 besonders bedeutend, weil die Fed der dominante Markt-Treiber ist.
regime_sensitive.thresholds: Unter 80 = ruhig (selten seit 2022). 80-120 = erhoehte Basisvol (neue Normalitaet). 120-150 = Stress. Ueber 150 = akute Anleihen-Krise. 180+ = Panik (Maerz 2023, Sept 2022).
regime_sensitive.why_it_matters: Hohe Bond-Vol strahlt auf alle Assets: HYG leidet direkt (Spreads), DBC indirekt (Dollar-Vol), GLD kann profitieren (Safe Haven) oder leiden (steigende Real Yields). MOVE ueber 150 = systemisches Warnsignal.

regime_sensitive.name: HYG Fund Flows (Wochenzufluesse)
regime_sensitive.what: Netto-Kapitalzufluesse in High-Yield-Bond-Fonds. Positive Flows = Anleger kaufen Kreditrisiko. Negative = Anleger verkaufen. Direktes Mass fuer Nachfrage nach genau der Asset-Klasse unserer groessten Position.
regime_sensitive.thresholds: Ueber +$500M/Wo = starke Zufluesse. 0 bis +$500M = neutral. -$500M bis 0 = leichte Abfluesse. -$500M bis -$1B = erhoehte Abfluesse. Unter -$1B = Kapitalflucht (akutes Warnsignal).
regime_sensitive.why_it_matters: Direkt relevant fuer HYG — anhaltende Abfluesse druecken den Kurs auch ohne fundamentale Spread-Veraenderung, weil ETF-Market-Maker Anleihen liquidieren muessen.
